AW.name: Aruba
AW.note: Aruba is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands with its own entry rules. Its visa list broadly follows the Dutch one; confirm with the Departamento di Integracion, Maneho y Admision di Stranhero (DIMAS).
AW.stay: Stays of up to 30 days are granted on arrival, extendable to 180 days a year.

CW.name: Curacao
CW.note: Curacao is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands with its own entry rules. Its visa list broadly follows the Dutch one; confirm with Curacao immigration before booking.
CW.stay: Stays of up to 90 days are granted on arrival.

KY.name: Cayman Islands
KY.note: The Cayman Islands are a British Overseas Territory setting their own entry rules. The visa-national list broadly follows the UK's; confirm with Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control.
KY.stay: Stays of up to 30 days are granted on arrival, extendable.

PF.name: French Polynesia
PF.note: French Polynesia is a French overseas collectivity with its own entry stamp. Its short-stay visa list follows France's; confirm with the Haut-Commissariat before booking.
PF.stay: Stays of up to 90 days in any 180 for nationalities admitted without a visa.

PR.name: Puerto Rico
PR.note: Puerto Rico is a US territory and applies United States immigration law — the answer below is the US rule, exactly.

SX.name: Sint Maarten
SX.note: Sint Maarten is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands with its own entry rules. Its visa list broadly follows the Dutch one; confirm with Sint Maarten immigration before booking.
SX.stay: Stays of up to 90 days are granted on arrival.

TC.name: Turks and Caicos
TC.note: Turks and Caicos is a British Overseas Territory setting its own entry rules. The visa-national list broadly follows the UK's; confirm with the TCI Immigration Department.
TC.stay: Stays of up to 90 days are granted on arrival.

VI.name: US Virgin Islands
VI.note: The US Virgin Islands apply United States immigration law — the answer below is the US rule, exactly.
